description: List all registered git repositories with name, branch, commit_count, file_count, indexed-symbol_count, latest_commit, last_fetched_at, and import_state. Optional min_commits and branch filters; limit/offset accepted for forward compatibility.

branch.description: Filter to repositories whose default branch matches this string

min_commits.description: Only return repositories with at least this many commits

offset.description: Forward-compat: skip the first N rows

name: list_repositories
